deploy-bot: Deploy initiated to prod-eu1 · tag=`release-1.5.0` · commit=`4f3b2a9` · canary=3 pods · rollout strategy=gradual

alex kim: seeing an uptick in 503s from canary pods, tailing logs now

priya shah: confirming, dashboard shows error-rate spike ~30s after canary start :eyes:

marco rios: @priya can you paste the failing stack traces? if it's a config issue we should abort and revert to previous stable

priya shah: logs (snip):
```
ERROR HttpHandler - upstream 502 on /v1/generate
java.lang.IllegalStateException: KV cache mismatch
```

priya shah: looks like a runtime mismatch with the new runtime flags, probably model runtime arg parsing

alex kim: canary latency also doubled, health-checks flapping on 2/3 canary pods

marco rios: ok i'm going to undo the release. plan: 1) halt rollout 2) revert canary to previous tag 3) pin cluster to `release-1.4.2` until postmortem. start rollback now?

sasha ng: +1 from SRE, keep me posted on traffic shaping, don't prod main until canary is stable

marco rios: `/deploy revert --env prod-eu1 --to-tag release-1.4.2 --reason "canary runtime mismatch"`

deploy-bot: Rollback command received from @marco rios. Initiating revert to tag `release-1.4.2` (commit `1a2b3c`). Stages: canary -> gradual -> finalize. Estimated time: ~2m.

release-engineer-bot: Change-window check: current window open (approved by @sasha ng). No approval blockers.

deploy-bot: Rolling back canary: terminating 3 pods with tag `release-1.5.0` and replacing with `release-1.4.2`...

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed · all canary pods now at `release-1.4.2` · health checks stable (ok=3/3)

marco rios: pinning service to `release-1.4.2` in the routing config to prevent auto-rollforward. command:`/service pin --service inference-api --tag release-1.4.2`

deploy-bot: Service `inference-api` pinned to `release-1.4.2` · pin id=`pin-2026-03-20-01`

deploy-bot: Continuing rollback across cluster: reverting remaining replicas in prod-eu1...

deploy-bot: Full revert completed · prod-eu1 running `release-1.4.2` across all replicas · rollout status=success · revert-commit=`1a2b3c`

priya shah: confirmed no errors on post-rollback smoke tests. reverting was clean.

alex kim: creating a short incident note and adding the failing logs, will follow up with an action item to test runtime flag parsing in CI

sasha ng: thanks everyone. next steps: block auto-deploys for 24h, add a Canary test that asserts KV cache compatibility, and coordinate a patched deploy once we have a hotfix branch.

marco rios: agree. will open a PR for runtime flag guard and schedule a redeploy once QA signs off.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket ID `INC-20260320-142` created by @alex kim. If you need to trigger a redeploy use `/deploy start --tag <hotfix-tag> --env prod-eu1` after approvals.

sasha ng: marking this thread resolved for the immediate rollback; keep the incident linked to the release notes. :white_check_mark:

alex kim: thanks — good catch on the canary monitoring, nice quick revert everyone.
